header.title: Prohibited & Banned Items
header.subtitle: To comply with international safety laws and carrier regulations, the following commodities are strictly prohibited from being shipped via Bombino Express.

categories.title: Hazardous & Biological Commodities
items: All IATA restricted items and dangerous goods
Dry ice (including that used for packaging)

categories.title: Financial & High-Value Assets
items: Money (coins, paper money, and negotiable instruments)

categories.title: Illegal, Regulated & Weapons
items: Gambling devices: lottery tickets and gambling devices where prohibited by law

categories.title: Electronics & Perishables
items: Electronic and electrical products and spare parts with battery source
Foodstuffs/perishables (food and beverages requiring refrigeration or environmental control)

categories.title: Operational & Statutory Restrictions
items: Commodities banned by law at any given time without prior notice
Any shipment likely to cause delay or damage to equipment, personnel, or other shipments
Any shipment that may require the carrier to obtain a license for its transportation
Any item whose carriage is prohibited by any law, statute, or regulation of the country of origin, destination, or transit
